business_summary: AP Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages restaurants in Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, and the United States. The company operates through two segments, Sales Business, and Production and Distribution Business. The Sales Business segment engages in the food and beverage business at restaurants. The Production and Distribution Business segment distributes food and beverages, as well as produces and distributes free-range chickens and other live foods, fish, fruit, vegetables, etc. in addition, it manages poultry farms and ranch, and import and export products. The company was formerly known as AP Company Co., Ltd. AP Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
